item.title: 🚨 Baabda sources to Al Jadeed: -Lebanon received a commitment from the U.S. side to provide answers
item.description:
🚨
Baabda sources to Al Jadeed:
-Lebanon received a commitment from the U.S. side to provide answers regarding the ceasefire.
-A new security agreement regulating the situation along the border was discussed, along with its legal reference, whether through the United Nations or the United States.
-Discussions on the third party tasked with verification were completed, and a shortlist was reached in preparation for selecting one in the next phase.
-No final results were reached regarding the pilot areas, with Lebanon insisting on moving to new areas, while Israel insisted on first carrying out verification in the initial two areas.
-September 1 was proposed as a preliminary date for a new round of negotiations, while the U.S. side will continue separate contacts with both parties until a final date is set.
──────────────
